For Prospective Students
Graduate Programs
What Can I Study in Graduate School at Michigan Tech?
Take what you know further. At Michigan Technological University, graduate study gives
you the opportunity to dive deeper into your field, explore new questions, and develop
the expertise to put your ideas to work. Michigan Tech offers master's and PhD programs across engineering, computing, sciences, business, health, sustainability, natural
resources, and the humanities and social sciences. Whether you're preparing for a
career, advancing your expertise, or pursuing research that can change what comes
next, you'll find programs designed to help you take on meaningful challenges.
Which Graduate Program Is Right for Me?
Start with what interests you. Michigan Tech's graduate programs span hundreds of
areas of interest, from artificial intelligence and robotics to environmental sustainability,
human health, advanced materials, forest science, business analytics, and beyond.
Explore areas of interest within each program to see where your academic and research
interests align with the work happening at Michigan Tech. Our research-active faculty
bring real-world questions into the classroom and lab, giving you opportunities to
build knowledge, work across disciplines, and contribute to research that matters.
Should I Pursue a Master's or PhD?
Master's programs can help you build advanced knowledge and specialized skills, prepare
for professional practice, or develop a foundation for further research. Depending
on the program, master's students may have coursework, report, or research options.
Many of our graduate certificates on campus can build into a Master’s degree.
PhD programs are research-focused and are designed for students who want to make original
contributions to their field through advanced study and research.
Your goals can help determine which degree is right for you. Explore individual programs
to learn about degree requirements, areas of study, research opportunities, and the
path that best fits your goals.
Can I Earn a Graduate Degree Online?
Graduate study doesn't have to look the same for everyone. Michigan Tech offers online graduate degrees and certificates that give you the flexibility to continue your education while balancing work, family,
and other commitments. Online students receive the same rigorous education and earn
the same Michigan Tech degree as students studying on campus.
Graduate certificates provide another way to build specialized skills, whether you
want to strengthen your expertise, prepare for a new career direction, or complement
a graduate degree. Some certificates can also be pursued alongside a master's or PhD.
Who Can Help Me Find the Right Graduate Program?
You don't have to figure it out alone. Each Michigan Tech graduate program has a Graduate Program Director who serves as a primary point of contact and can help you understand the program,
courses, expectations, and opportunities available to you. Graduate Program Assistants
provide additional administrative support, and program faculty can help you explore
research interests and potential areas of specialization. If you're considering graduate
school but aren't sure where to start, exploring program directors, faculty, and areas of interest can help you connect your goals with the right program.
Where Could Graduate Study at Michigan Tech Take Me?
Graduate school is about more than earning another credential. It's about developing
the knowledge, experience, and confidence to tackle problems that don't have easy
answers. At Michigan Tech, you'll join a community of graduate students and faculty
who are curious, collaborative, and driven to put their expertise to work, unlocking
the benefits of further study and academic experience. Explore our graduate programs, discover the research happening in your areas of
interest, and find the opportunity that will help you turn what you're curious about
into what you can accomplish.
Your ideas have somewhere to go.
Take your interests further through advanced study and hands-on research.
